l.i: IN ꝗVA SYNODI ECCLESIARVM IN GALLIA
Reformatarum Nationalis, Carentoni propè Lutetiam anno 1645. habitæ, de illo Argumento Decretum explicatur & defenditur. Ac Placæi cum illo Decreto summus per omnia consensus demonstratur.

page.notes: The words PRIMI and PLACÆI and ADAMI are underlined in green/yellow ink (handwritten marking, not printed). The woodcut ornament between the description and the imprint is an engraving, not text. The "ꝗVA" in the Latin descriptive line is a printed abbreviation for "quâ" rendered as printed. Line "IN QVA" is set in italic with a swash Q; read as printed.
